messages:
anya: Heads up — since the 22:00 runtime deploy we see a 99p host-side latency spike for small requests (single-turn, ~80 tokens). Looks like CPU on the proxy/ingress jumped and grpc small-write tail got worse.

mike: Can you paste the perf sample or pprof?

anya: Quick flame snippet from the host where the spike happens:
```
99.3%  cpu  ingress_proxy  52%  writev_small_chunks
12.7%  cpu  preparse      15%  tokenize_inline
7.1%   cpu  runtime        8%  kvcache_eviction
4.0%   cpu  kernel_select  6%  fallback_generic_matmul
```
Not huge but the write path + tokenize_inline correlate with the tail.

sam: perf-bot ran a quick A/B this morning, posted numbers in the infra dashboard. perf-bot: baseline->after-deploy (p50/p95/p99): 12ms/28ms/140ms -> 13ms/34ms/420ms. Increased 99p ~3x.

rachel: KV cache stats? could be more evictions leading to extra work during decode.

anya: KV eviction rate doubled for hot shards (shard ids 17/18). Logs show a burst of small requests that are not being coalesced so KV lookups thrash the cache.

mike: Two hypotheses: 1) kernel selection fallback is slower for these shapes (we picked a matmul fallback for short seqs), 2) ingress writev/coalesce window got narrower in the proxy change, so we pay syscall/write overhead.

sam: I can toggle the proxy write_coalesce_ms to previous value and rerun. If p99 drops quickly it's the coalescing window.

anya: Also trying a quick host patch to pin kernel to fast-atten-weight for seq<=128 to rule out fallback cost.

infra-bot: Canary run scheduled — proxy.coalesce_ms reverted to 4 -> rolling on 10 hosts.

perf-bot: Canary results (first 5m): p99 dropped from 420ms -> 160ms for that traffic slice. p95 unchanged.

rachel: Interesting — p95 steady, p99 moves a lot. Points at batching/write aggregation rather than model compute. Kernel pin helps but less impact than coalesce change?

anya: Exactly. Kernel pin gave ~10% p99 improvement, coalesce revert gave ~60% improvement. Looks like small-write syscall overhead dominates in mini-bursts.

mike: Action items:
- sam: keep proxy coalesce at 4ms and run 2h smoke across regions (owner: sam).
- anya: open a short-term kernel pin PR for seq<=128 and add a perf test (owner: anya).
- rachel: investigate KV hotspot eviction pattern, possible relaxed prefetch for shards 17/18 (owner: rachel).

anya: I'll also add tracing around writev vs write to verify we aren't regressing elsewhere. Will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

sam: started the 2h smoke, will update on completion.

infra-bot: 2h smoke started at 1789997779.

perf-bot: smoke complete (2h) — p99 back to baseline for affected slice, no throughput loss observed.

mike: Great. We should keep coalesce config as default until we can optimize the proxy's batching heuristics to avoid latency cliffs while preserving throughput.

anya: Agreed. Leaving thread open for follow-ups on kernel selection improvements and KV prefetching.
